signup_waitlist_policy_content.name: signup_waitlist_policy_content
signup_waitlist_policy_content.default:
'WAITLIST COMMUNICATIONS & PRIVACY NOTICE

By requesting an invite, you consent to receive an email when signup slots reopen.

What we collect:
- Your name and email address
- Basic client metadata (IP address and user agent)

How we use it:
- To notify you when signup slots open
- We do not sell your data

Retention:
- We retain waitlist records until you are invited or you opt out

Opt-out:
- You can opt out by replying to an invite email or contacting support.'
